limitations: Video/audio streams were not downloadable from this environment (YouTube bot-check + PO-token gating); visual metrics come from YouTube storyboard frames (180px cells, one sample every ~1.96 s in Era B, ~0.99 s in Era A).
Cut frequency is therefore a LOWER bound; camera motion inside a shot is not measurable.
Transcripts were not retrievable (timedtext endpoint returned empty bodies); dialogue evidence comes from burned-in captions visible in storyboard frames.
Audio characteristics are inferred from description credits and visible captions, not measured.

moral_reversal_drama.why_selected: Era B median views 330,570 vs 26,852 for Era A (12.3x); median views/day 27,289 vs 230 (119x); like rate 2.93% vs 1.59%. The channel itself abandoned Era A after 2026-10-05.

cadence.observed: 36/41 uploads between 10:00 and 12:59 UTC, one per day, all weekdays

title.grammar_evidence: age-adjusted log-view residual medians: general_maxim +0.28 (n=19), question +0.72 (n=1), narrative_teaser -0.31 (n=11), imperative -0.39 (n=10)

description.observed_template: editor credit + software + music track credit + fair-use disclaimer + ~29 edit hashtags
description.engine_policy: Do NOT copy the fair-use disclaimer or edit-hashtags (they describe reused footage). Generate an honest description: one-line story summary, 'Original fictional dramatization' notice, sources for any factual payoff, AI-disclosure, 3-5 relevant hashtags.

structure.notes: First frame is mid-scene with >=2 characters already in tension; POV title bar on screen 0-~6 s
Who is the underdog, who is the antagonist, the setting; dialogue only, no narrator
Antagonist humiliates/accuses/judges the underdog; bystanders react
A manager/police/owner/third party arrives; wider group shots
Twist: hidden identity/status/evidence (e.g. 'This is your wallet' at 75%, 'I'm your new boss' at 90%)
Antagonist faces consequence; final reaction close-up; no spoken CTA observed

narrative.most_frequent_theme: prejudice_appearance (10/41) - most frequent and contains the top video (25.6M), but median slightly below era median after age adjustment
narrative.confidence: medium (structure seen consistently in sampled timelines; per-theme effects low confidence)

visual.aspect: 9:16 full-frame (no letterbox), subjects centred, faces in upper-middle third
visual.shot_mix_evidence: manual reading of full timelines of 4-WzLJxiPJk and TTqUFtjdBLE: predominantly single-person close-ups in shot/reverse-shot, wide group shots cluster in the authority/reveal beats

ending_shot.observed: 33/41 close-up reaction, 4/41 fade to black, 4/41 medium

grade.look: bright, high-clarity 'HDR' look, warm skin with teal/cyan shadows, soft glow

title_bar.style: white full-width strip at very top (~7% of height), black condensed bold uppercase, 1-2 lines

watermark.engine_policy: use own configurable brand handle or none; never the reference handle

visual.black_frames: only intentional fade-to-black at the end (1/41 had dark frames mid-video)

captions.style: bold condensed sans, line 1 smaller, line 2 (keyword) larger; strong coloured glow; colour rotates per line among yellow/green/magenta/blue/orange
captions.evidence: storyboard frames of c8n65RTCZz8, 4-WzLJxiPJk, TTqUFtjdBLE; caption_frame_ratio median 0.596 across 41 Era B videos; weak positive Spearman with age-adjusted performance (0.195)
captions.confidence: high for style/position, low for performance effect

transitions.evidence: blended double-exposure frame at the reveal in TTqUFtjdBLE (146 s); otherwise hard cuts

audio.dialogue: character dialogue carries the whole story (no narrator)
audio.music: single recurring dark/cloud-rap/phonk-style bed credited in all 41 Era B descriptions ('I'm god'); edit hashtags #PhonkEdit #DarkEdit
audio.music_policy: use original or licensed music only; ducked under dialogue

narrated_recap.status: secondary / not recommended (12x lower median views)

captions.style: single white bold lowercase/uppercase word, no glow

narrated_recap.engine_policy: Only for original/public-domain stories; never recap copyrighted films.

originality_policy.evidence: Era B descriptions state: 'This video contains copyrighted content, including images, video, and music owned by their respective creators'; early Era B titles name TV series (Tacoma FD, Kim's Convenience, Grey's Anatomy, Law & Order SVU).
engine_rules: Reproduce only abstract structure, pacing, caption and grade characteristics.
All stories, dialogue, characters and visuals are original; no clips, frames, audio or scripts from the reference channel or the works it uses.
Every factual payoff (law, policy, statistic) must cite a source; stories are labelled as fictional dramatizations.
No imitation of the reference creator's voice, handle, watermark or branding.
